title: H. pylori breath test
what: You drink a special solution and breathe into a bag or tube. Your breath shows if H. pylori bacteria are in your stomach.
why: For stomach pain, heartburn, ulcers, or to check after H. pylori treatment.
duration: usually 30 to 40 minutes; results often come the same day
tell_doctor: If you took antibiotics in the last month
If you take medicines for heartburn or stomach acid
If you were ever treated for H. pylori, and when you finished

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Fasting: usually no food for 6 hours. Ask the clinic if water is allowed.

prepare.title: Smoking and gum
prepare.text: On the test day, do not smoke or chew gum.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Antibiotics and acid medicines can change the result. Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor. They will decide.

steps: You breathe into the first bag or tube. This is the baseline sample
You drink a glass of the solution. It usually tastes a bit sour
You sit quietly, usually for 15 to 30 minutes
You breathe into the second bag or tube
The samples are sent for testing
feel: Nothing unpleasant. You just need to wait quietly
after: You can eat right away and go back to your day
Results usually come the same or the next day. The lab will tell you when

faq.a: Yes. A non-radioactive solution is usually used. It is also fine for checking after treatment.

faq.q: When should I be retested after treatment?
faq.a: Usually at least 4 weeks after treatment ends. Your doctor will tell you when.

reminders.text: H. pylori breath test today. For 6 hours before, do not eat, smoke, or chew gum.
